commands.START GALEZI: Inventory only the selected module/card, identify its files and dependencies, and establish the starting point. Do not modify other modules.
commands.TEST: Apply only the single explicitly agreed change and stop for device testing.
commands.MASTER ZAMROZ: Register the user-approved state as immutable MASTER with commit, files, assets and dependencies.
commands.KONTROLA CZYSTOSCI: Check duplicates, obsolete CSS/JS, orphan files, duplicate engines, stale assets, MASTER/LIVE conflicts and cross-module modifications before continuing.
commands.ODBLOKUJ MASTER: Allowed only after explicit user approval naming the MASTER to unlock.

policy: Every future module and card must follow this protocol. If a requested change conflicts with a locked MASTER, stop that change and report the conflict instead of silently modifying the MASTER.
